objective_summary.value: The investigation aims to plan and support microgravity flight testing on the International Space Station to determine conditions under which cool diffusion flames occur. It also seeks to perform CFD simulations and identify chemical kinetics mechanisms that match space station measurements.
objective_summary.quote: 1. Plan and support flight testing on the International Space Station (ISS).

earth_applications.value: Testing and advancing cool flame kinetics mechanisms should facilitate the development of more efficient internal combustion engines on Earth.
earth_applications.quote: This should facilitate the development of more efficient internal combustion engines.
